name: My Macros+ | Macro Tracker
description:
Track your meals in as little as 3 taps. Join 1,000,000+ users who've reached their goals with My Macros+ — the diet tracker built by a professional bodybuilder, for people who are serious about results.

FAST, ACCURATE TRACKING 
Scan barcodes and nutrition labels for instant logging. Search a database of over 5 million foods. AI photo scanning is there when you need it.

BUILT YOUR WAY
Set your macros exactly how you want, unlimited meals with Pro, any food in any serving size. My Macros+ adapts to how you eat — not the other way around.

AS FEATURE ON
Good Morning America, Men's Health, AskMen, and DailyBurn.

WHY MY MACROS+ 
Created after years of frustration with existing diet apps, My Macros+ is built around one idea: tracking should be fast enough that you actually stick with it. From first-time dieters to elite athletes, our users stay consistent because tracking takes seconds, not minutes.

CUSTOMIZE EVERY DETAIL
- Create unlimited macro goals with Pro — supports carb cycling, high/low days, and refeeds
- Add as many meals per day as you want — no forced Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner structure
- Create custom foods fast — enter them straight from the label or snap a photo. No math required
- Edit any food to any serving size you want
- Smart food search and categorization speed up every entry
- Works offline — hundreds of thousands of preloaded foods from popular brands and restaurants, ready when you are

SEE YOUR PROGRESS

- Daily, meal-level, and per-food nutrition breakd
